parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside under test directories — 'Shared/Playback/Tests/RadioPlayerTests/RadioPlayerControllerTests.swift', 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift' (two entries), and 'Shared/PartyHorn/Tests/PartyHornTests/SoundPlayerTests.swift' — making these unambiguously test/mock artifacts despite the pipeline reporting is_test=false. The name collision of MockAudioSession across the Playback and PartyHorn packages is conventional: each package maintains its own isolated mock of the audio session to avoid cross-package test coupling. No structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor) was computed, so there is no field-level basis to assert the aliases are identical or mergeable. Consolidating them into a shared mock target would couple unrelated test suites and undermine test isolation.
